assessments.name: Reading reflection/Discussion posts
assessments.description: Submit a one-paragraph reflection on the week's readings to the Canvas discussion forum. The reflection should include a considered response to the readings and questions for clarification and/or discussion. You must attempt at least one to pass the unit.

assessments.name: Research essay
assessments.description: Question to be provided in the first few weeks of the unit. The essay focuses on your ability to synthesise and deploy the theories covered in Weeks 1-5.

assessments.name: Short-release take-home exercise
assessments.description: Two essays of 1,000 words each undertaken independently, available via Canvas. Interpreting questions and finding additional sources are part of this process. No queries on these issues will be acknowledged.
